title: Indexing Pipeline Configuration Examples

examples.name: fixed
examples.description: Fixed windows provide predictable chunk sizes and work across text formats.

examples.name: structured
examples.description: Structured splitting preserves headings or code boundaries before applying a size limit.

notes: Use the same embedding model for both strategies.
Keep generated indexes outside the source document directory.
Inspect chunk metadata before evaluating semantic search.
Do not treat estimated page count as an exact physical page count.
